environments.cold: fresh Node and writer processes per sample; OS page cache not purged; process/module/JIT startup included in wallMs
environments.hot: persistent Node and writer processes, 3 or configured discarded warmups per case; resources cached in Node; writer resources reloaded each job
environments.scope: wallMs includes resource load, render, IR/resource spool, both writers and output file writes. Stage write timers exclude input/output filesystem I/O. Queue/network/HTTP/source attachment excluded; no HTTP seam exists yet.
environments.memory: Node maxRSS and CLR PeakWorkingSet are separate process high-water marks, not their sum or a sampled per-job peak. Hot marks are cumulative from process startup including warmup.
